We use four automatic evaluation metrics: mean reciprocal rank (MRR), and Hits@k(k∈{1,3,10}) (H@k for short).

Following previous work, our proposed KGC model is evaluated with entity ranking task: for each test triple (h, r, t), tail entity prediction ranks all entities to predict t given h and r, similarly for head entity prediction. We use four automatic evaluation metrics: mean reciprocal rank (MRR), and Hits@k(k ∈{1,3,10}) (H@k for short).
We also conduct a human evaluation on the Wikidata5M dataset to provide a more accurate estimate of the model's performance.
